messages.text:
The ptest sweep exposed two useful things: some generated argument strings carry trailing blanks, and eza treats missing-path OS errors 2 and 3 as exit status 2.

I’m also adding aliases for long options that are metadata columns so they don’t trip the parser when they appear in benchmark cases.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); & $ref --color=never --icons=never -R probe; "status=$LASTEXITCODE"; & $ref --color=never --icons=never -R -l probe; "status=$LASTEXITCODE"; & $ref --color=never --icons=never -T -L 1 probe; "status=$LASTEXITCODE"; & $ref --color=never --icons=never -T -L 2 probe; "status=$LASTEXITCODE"'
